zh: 相邻两个长度 k 的窗口只差首尾两个元素，所以所有窗口和相等等价于对所有合法 i 都有 a[i] = a[i+k]。
按下标模 k 分组，各组互不影响，每组最终必须全部相同。原本已全相同的组不用改；否则修改后的统一值必须是正整数，只能保留等于某个正值的那些位置。
k ≥ n 时直接输出 0；对每个余数 r 取出 r, r+k, r+2k, … 位置的元素；组内只有一种值就跳过；否则统计各正值的出现次数，答案加上组大小减最高正值频次（没有正值时频次为 0）。
en: Two adjacent windows of length k differ only in their first and last elements, so all window sums are equal exactly when a[i] = a[i+k] for every valid i.

Group the indices by index mod k; the groups are independent and each must end up constant. A group that is already constant needs no change; otherwise the common value after changes must be a positive integer, so only positions equal to one positive value can be kept.

If k >= n, output 0; for each remainder r take the elements at r, r+k, r+2k, ...; skip the group if it holds a single value; otherwise count the occurrences of each positive value and add the group size minus the highest positive frequency (0 when there is no positive value).

explanationEn:
## Approach

Subtracting adjacent windows gives a[i]=a[i+k]. Group the indices by index mod k: a group whose values are already all equal stays unchanged; any other group is unified to its most frequent positive value, or entirely changed to 1 if it has no positive value.

## Proof of correctness

All windows having the same sum is equivalent to every group being constant, and different groups do not interfere. If a group needs no change, any original value can be kept; when a change is needed, the target can only be a positive integer, so at most the highest frequency of a positive value in that group can be kept. Every group reaches its lower bound, and summing gives the global optimum.

## Complexity

Time O(n+k), space O(n).
